race.comment: KHORASAN (9) is the one to beat after two solid soft-track runs, first placing here over 1350m behind Expecto Patronum before a luckless fifth at Murray Bridge when slow away and held up near the 400m. The return to 1200m is the query, but she has been competitive in stronger. In the mix. KARMA QUEEN (8) has been costly as a long-standing maiden, yet she has placed at this venue and has enough 1200m ratings to stay in the argument. Each-way. DESERT CHARM (1) is improving quickly, was wide throughout when fifth at Gawler, beaten a length and a half, and gets blinkers for the first time from a kinder draw. Can give this a shake. NOLABELL (13) solid Balaklava placing first-up and has Listed race experience. Further improvement expected.
